intro.en: I contribute to open source and build web apps and CLI tools using TypeScript and Python.
intro.ja: TypeScriptとPythonを使い、OSSへのコントリビュートやWebアプリ・CLIの開発をしています。

availability.ja: 業務委託案件を募集しています。

https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pul.en: Reproduced and fixed an issue where Active Memory `recall error` messages leaked into prompts.
https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pul.ja: Active Memoryの`recall error`がpromptに混ざる問題を再現し、修正。

https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/pull/13885.en: Updated the Rust implementation to support reading `.modules.yaml` files containing long dependency paths.
https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/pull/13885.ja: 長い依存パスを含む`.modules.yaml`をRust側でも読めるよう修正。

https://github.com/jestjs/jest/pull/1632.en: Added support for rerunning tests at the `describe` level with `jest.retryTimes()`.

https://github.com/jestjs/jest/pull/1634.en: Fixed an issue where retries also deleted inline snapshots outside the retried test.
https://github.com/jestjs/jest/pull/1634.ja: 再試行時に、対象外のinline snapshotまで削除される問題を修正。

https://github.com/jestjs/jest/pull/1634.en: Fixed an issue where a late `done` callback affected subsequent tests.
https://github.com/jestjs/jest/pull/1634.ja: 遅れて呼ばれた`done` callbackが後続テストへ影響する問題を修正。

https://github.com/jestjs/jest/pull/1634.en: Fixed an issue where `currentlyRunningTest` remained set after skipped or todo tests.
https://github.com/jestjs/jest/pull/1634.ja: skipまたはtodoの後も`currentlyRunningTest`が残る問題を修正。

https://github.com/activist-org/activist.en: Standardized sidebar icon sizes and added regression tests.
https://github.com/activist-org/activist.ja: サイドバーのアイコンサイズを統一し、回帰テストを追加。

https://github.com/dheerajjha/mcp-migrat.en: Displayed the number of hidden items in the list and added validation and tests for invalid values.
https://github.com/dheerajjha/mcp-migrat.ja: 非表示項目数を一覧へ表示。不正値の検証とテストも追加。

https://github.com/open-telemetry/opente.en: Prevented duplicate span completion when an `ioredis` callback fires more than once.
https://github.com/open-telemetry/opente.ja: `ioredis` callbackが複数回呼ばれてもspanを重複終了しないよう修正。

https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pu.en: Added `console.trace()` stack output to worker logs while preserving existing Inspector and tail behavior.
https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/pu.ja: worker logへ`console.trace()`のstackを追加し、Inspectorとtailの既存動作を維持。

https://github.com/jestjs/jest/pull/1642.en: Documented why mocks can miss separately installed copies of a dependency and how to work around it.
https://github.com/jestjs/jest/pull/1642.ja: 同じ依存モジュールが別々にインストールされているとモックが適用されない理由と、回避方法をドキュメントに追加。

https://github.com/open-telemetry/opente.en: Excluded empty context propagation attributes that cause SQS and SNS to reject messages, and corrected handling of the 10-attribute limit.
https://github.com/open-telemetry/opente.ja: SQS・SNSがメッセージを拒否する原因となる空のコンテキスト伝播属性を除外し、属性数の上限10件の判定も修正。

https://github.com/oxc-project/oxc/pull/.en: Fixed false positives in `no-useless-spread` so spreads around `slice()` results are preserved when the receiver type is unknown.
https://github.com/oxc-project/oxc/pull/.ja: `no-useless-spread`の誤検出を修正し、呼び出し元の型が不明な`slice()`の結果ではスプレッド構文を維持。

https://github.com/angular/components/pu.en: Fixed stale row templates in `CdkTable` when `trackBy` preserves row identity but the row definition changes.
https://github.com/angular/components/pu.ja: `CdkTable`で`trackBy`による行の識別が変わらなくても、行定義が変わればテンプレートを更新するよう修正。

https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchai.en: Made `ChatBedrockConverse` honor retry settings, limiting streaming retries to initialization to avoid duplicate output.
https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchai.ja: `ChatBedrockConverse`に再試行設定を反映し、ストリーミングでは出力の重複を避けるため再試行を初期化時に限定。

summary.en: Verified snapshot paths appear only in external snapshot failures, in both Circus and Jasmine.
summary.ja: 外部スナップショットの失敗時だけパスを表示する変更を、CircusとJasmineで検証。

summary.en: Found an insertion-order bug in overlapping table-key interpolation and verified the fix and regression tests.
summary.ja: prefixが重なるtable keyの補間に挿入順依存があることを指摘し、修正と回帰テストを確認。

summary.en: Verified a type error in custom matcher result types with TypeScript 5.4 and 5.9.
summary.ja: `custom matcher`の結果型で出る型エラーをTypeScript 5.4/5.9で確認。

summary.en: An autoplaying 2048 web app with jazz and hand claps.
summary.ja: AIが2048を自動プレイし、ジャズに合わせてタイルが動く音楽付きWebアプリ。

summary.en: Estimates remaining lifetime and free time based on official Japanese statistics. All inputs are processed locally.
summary.ja: 日本の公的統計から、統計上の残り時間と自由時間を計算。入力内容は端末内だけで処理。

summary.en: A bilingual profile site built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Cloudflare Pages.
summary.ja: HTML・CSS・JavaScriptで作った、Cloudflare Pages上の日英プロフィールサイト。

summary.en: A textlint rule and agent integrations for using role-theory phrasing in Japanese AI chats.
summary.ja: AIの日本語チャットに「役割論理」のロジカル語法を取り入れるtextlintルールとエージェント連携ツール。

summary.en: A read-only MCP server for searching the SCP Wiki and retrieving source, author, and licensing information.
summary.ja: SCP Wikiを検索し、出典、作者、ライセンス情報を取得する読み取り専用MCPサーバー。

summary.en: A CLI and TUI for finding SCP anomaly pairings with explanations.
summary.ja: SCPの異常存在の組み合わせを、理由とともに提示するCLI・TUI。

summary.en: A local CLI that archives video metadata, subtitles, speech-to-text transcripts, and text extracted from images as Markdown.
summary.ja: 動画の情報、字幕、音声認識、画像内の文字をMarkdownで保存するローカルCLI。

summary.en: An offline CLI for screening work requests and identifying risks and questions.
summary.ja: 仕事の募集文を読み込み、受ける候補かどうかと、注意点や確認事項を出力するオフラインCLI。
